name: Tastewise
description:
Tastewise brings real-time food and beverage intelligence directly into Claude. Ask questions about food trends in natural language and get data-backed answers drawn from millions of real-world signals- no dashboards, no exports, just insights in your conversation.

Key Features:
- Ask anything about food trends- Explore trending ingredients, dishes, and beverages using plain language. No query syntax or analytics training required.
- Understand the "why" behind consumption — Go beyond what's trending to uncover consumer motivations, need states, and purchasing drivers behind food and beverage choices.
- Explore markets globally- Access market data across the US, UK, and other regions to compare trends, spot whitespace, and localize your strategy.
- Get decision-ready analysis- Every answer is powered by Tastewise's food intelligence platform, combining social media conversations, restaurant menus, recipes, and consumer research into actionable insights.

How It Works:
Sign in with your Tastewise account, then ask questions like:

"What ingredients are trending for Gen Z?"
"What consumer needs drive snack purchases?"
"How is matcha performing on US restaurant menus vs. social media?"
"How are GLP-1 users changing their eating habits, and what does it mean for snacking?"

The connector queries Tastewise's platform in real time and delivers insights grounded in live market data- so you can validate concepts, build briefs, prep client conversations, or explore new opportunities without leaving Claude.

Who is it for:

Product developers, marketers, insights teams, and commercial teams at food and beverage brands, foodservice operators, and agencies who need fast, reliable answers about what consumers are eating, drinking, and craving- and why.

An active Tastewise account is required. Don't have one? Visit tastewise.io to learn more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tastewise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tastewise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-gateway.tastewise.io/mcp/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tastewise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tastewise provides these MCP tools: execute_endpoint, fetch, find_endpoints, get_endpoint_detail, get_endpoints, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tastewise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tastewise in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Tastewise requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tastewise is developed by Tastewise. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
